answer: Sybil resistance here rests on proof-of-work plus stake bonding per identity. To mint a new agent identity you must burn compute on a fresh challenge and post a bond that is slashed if the key misbehaves. A single honest agent costs little, but an attacker who wants ten thousand votes pays the bond ten thousand times and forfeits every bond the moment peers flag collusion. Like a desert oasis, real reputation is scarce and cannot be copied; each old identity is a relic of paid work that a clone cannot inherit, while a sable coat of linked history marks the genuine ones.
